notes.title: This is not an update!
notes.notes:
I updated the achievements of other languages,I didn't know much language, so I used a translator. if there is a mistake, you can tell me ! thanks！:PuroHappy:

I also opened the creative workshop, but I don't know how to use it, so just pretend it didn't happen!:PuroaMazed:

I updated the mp3 version of OST, and now you can find them directly in the steam music library! just enjoy!:WhiteWolfHappy:

Changed does have a lot of things that are bad, and there are a lot of things that can be fixed in the game, but I really did my best. this is the first time I've tried to make a game. thank you for still choosing to play this game. I'll make sure I don't make mistakes again for the second time. Thank you!:DoctorK:
